checks: The shipped HTML preserves bearing, rack, rod, air, master-cylinder, booster and ABS faults through steering-kit purchase and real reload
A new run repairs the new components, keeps the steering kit, and Escape opens diagnostics with every new part
Actual VehiclePanel buttons call the native component repair system: isolated bearing/rod replacement, refill retains air, bleeding is gated on fluid and preserves master-cylinder damage
The real condition panel keeps long component descriptions within the row at desktop and 390-pixel width
limits: Persistence/new-run/diagnostics use final standalone bytes. Damaged-part service uses the shipped VehiclePanel and native physics in a local module harness; it does not test travelling to a garage or the main controller repair timer.
Software rendering; physical controls and subjective listening not tested.
